rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a brief flash of reflected light from something shiny.

example.english: A glint flashed off the blade.
example.jyutping: dou1 min6 faan2 se6 ceot1 jat1 dou6 sim2 gwong1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a brief flash or gleam of light.

example.english: The ring can glint briefly in the sunlight.
example.traditional: 戒指喺陽光下閃咗一下。
example.jyutping: gaai3 zi2 hai2 joeng4 gwong1 haa6 sim2 zo2 jat1 haa5

rows.note: Use this when the light glints or flickers repeatedly rather than just once.

example.english: The sign would glint repeatedly at night.
example.traditional: 個招牌喺夜晚不停閃爍。
example.jyutping: go3 ziu1 paai4 hai2 je6 maan5 bat1 ting4 sim2 soek3

rows.note: Use this when a shiny surface catches and reflects light, as with a ring or glass.

example.english: The polished tabletop can glint whenever it catches the light.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 min6 taai3 gwong1 seng4 jat6 faan2 gwong1
